The penalty position is governed by s.439(8), requiring a bona fide explanation and disclosure of all material facts.
mutated_regimes.reasoning: The receipt is a payment of USD 3,000 from a non-resident to a resident individual. Since it is not a transfer of a virtual digital asset, it does not fall under s.115BBH. Instead, it is classified as income from other sources. The recognition date is the date of credit (28 June 2026) as per the settlement datetime. The valuation method is determined by Rule 206, which specifies the telegraphic transfer buying rate on the last day of the tax year (31 March 2027) for income from other sources. TDS is applicable under s.393(1) if the threshold is exceeded, at a rate of 1%. The penalty position is governed by s.439(8), which requires a bona fide explanation and disclosure of all material facts.
